NoirPanther server **0.1.7-r2** — built from Stump **0.1.7**, fork revision 2.

## Fixes

- **Book titles from EPUB files with several `dc:title` elements** (main title, subtitle, full
  title — every Standard Ebooks file is like that) are no longer glued together with line breaks
  ("Frankenstein⏎Or, the Modern Prometheus⏎…"); the main title is used. Books that were already
  scanned pick it up after a library scan with _Force rebuild_.
- **Series from EPUB collections**: a book that belongs to several EPUB 3 collections (Standard
  Ebooks lists every "100 best novels" set next to the real series) got all of them glued into the
  series field, with a list position as the volume number. Collections are now matched to their
  `collection-type` / `group-position` through `refines`, and only a collection typed `series`
  names the series ("Sherlock Holmes" #3); a book that only sits in sets has no series.
- **Comic language**: `LanguageISO` from `ComicInfo.xml` is now read (only a non-standard
  `Language` tag was accepted before), so language filters and content rules work for comics.
- **Smaller image**: the web client folder is cleaned before every build — previous images
  carried ~2000 stale files from earlier builds (78 MB → 24 MB of client assets).
